summary: Verified the RetroCategorizeDialog CommandItem highlight-contrast fix (CSS-only). Confirmed the exact fix classes are present in /app/frontend/src/components/distributor/RetroCategorizeDialog.jsx line 191 ('data-[selected=true]:bg-violet-100 data-[selected=true]:text-slate-900 aria-selected:bg-violet-100') and sub-text uses text-slate-600 / text-slate-500. Confirmed the shadcn ui/command.jsx default is 'data-[selected=true]:bg-accent data-[selected=true]:text-accent-foreground' — which produced the dark-green-on-dark bug — and the override in RetroCategorizeDialog correctly wins (later utility). Attempted end-to-end trigger of the dialog from (a) /distributor/stock-transfers row ⋯ menus (10 rows), (b) 15 Stock In shipments and (c) 21 Stock Out deliveries on the Brian distributor: NONE surfaced the 'Categorize child SKU' menu item / 'Categorize' button. API inspection of /api/child-skus shows only ONE customer child SKU exists in this tenant (child_id ba79db11-…, parent_sku_id 8bc87348-…-'24 Brand', account 'Drive Folder Test Lead'); however NO completed stock transfer, shipment, or delivery in the tenant contains that parent SKU as a Generic (child_sku_id=null) line — all Generic completed transfers use 'Nyla – 330/600/660 ml' parents which have no customer children — so the retro entry points are correctly hidden and the dialog CANNOT be opened via UI in this environment. As per the review-request fallback, verified the fix by rendering a synthetic CommandItem with the exact applied classes in the running app (Tailwind JIT active) and reading getComputedStyle: highlighted background = rgb(237,233,254) = violet-100 (luminance 236/255, i.e. LIGHT — NOT the dark accent green), title text = rgb(30,41,59) slate-800 (lum 39.8, dark), sub-text = rgb(71,85,105) slate-600 (lum 83.1, dark). WCAG contrast for sub-text vs bg ≈ 6.4:1 — passes AA. Bug is fixed.
action_items: OPTIONAL (not a bug): The functional regression of the dialog (search filter -> option select -> chip + clear X, qty input max, Categorize enable) could not be exercised in this tenant because no completed transfer/shipment/delivery contains the 24 Brand parent SKU as a Generic line. If future regression coverage is desired, main agent could seed one such completed transfer (parent 8bc87348-5398-4604-92d8-eff59610b7f9 as Generic, status=completed, distributor with customer_account_id matching the customer child) OR add a Playwright story that renders the dialog with fixture props.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is scoped and correct — CommandItem override uses both data-[selected=true]:* (cmdk state) and aria-selected:* (a11y state), so both keyboard-arrow and pointer-hover highlights are covered.
Sub-text colors slate-600 / slate-500 provide sufficient contrast against violet-100 (~6.4:1 vs bg → passes WCAG AA for normal text).

Consider centralizing the override in ui/command.jsx (or a variant) to prevent recurrence of the same bug in other Command usages across the app — current shadcn default 'bg-accent text-accent-foreground' will keep producing dark-green-on-dark in any picker that doesn't override. Not a blocker for this ticket.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the contrast fix; functional regression BLOCKED by absent seed data

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only ONE customer child SKU exists (parent 8bc87348 '24 Brand'). No completed stock transfer/shipment/delivery references that parent as Generic, so RetroCategorizeDialog entry-point buttons (retro-categorize-transfer-btn-{id} / retro-categorize-shipment-item-{idx} / retro-categorize-delivery-item-{idx}) will not render in this tenant. To live-test the dialog UI, seed at least one completed transfer for a distributor whose account has a customer child SKU under parent 8bc87348.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (already fixed): shadcn CommandItem default classes 'data-[selected=true]:bg-accent data-[selected=true]:text-accent-foreground' render the highlighted option in the app's dark-green theme accent while the option's sub-text used dark slate → dark-on-dark, unreadable. FIX (verified in code and via Tailwind computed styles): RetroCategorizeDialog's CommandItem overrides with 'data-[selected=true]:bg-violet-100 data-[selected=true]:text-slate-900 aria-selected:bg-violet-100' and boosts sub-text to slate-600/slate-500. Highlighted state now renders on light violet with dark slate text (contrast ≈6.4:1, WCAG AA).
